visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A athletic man and woman stand on a bright blue running track under natural daylight. The woman, on the right, wears a black performance tank top and a specialized running vest with 'GARMIN' branding, her hands resting confidently on her waist while she speaks into a microphone held by an off-screen interviewer. The man on the left is similarly dressed in black athletic gear, wearing a visor and sunglasses, looking towards the interviewer. Behind them, a lush green hill and a scoreboard are visible, with several people in light blue shirts in the background. (2) Close-up on the woman as she laughs and gestures towards her face, adjusting her blue-tinted sunglasses resting on her forehead. The camera is steady at eye-level, capturing her bright facial expressions and micro-movements. The background remains the athletic track with other participants visible. Large green and white captions appear at the bottom of the screen to transcribe her speech. (3) The scene shifts to a graphic montage showing a group of runners in light blue t-shirts running together on the track. This is followed by a digital interface display on a smartphone showing a map of Taiwan with green tree icons indicating planted seedlings. The background for the digital UI is a clean white graphic. Promotional text for the 'Run For Green' event is displayed prominently in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with energetic, upbeat electronic pop music featuring a strong rhythmic beat and bright synthesizers. A female voice speaks with a high pitch and an enthusiastic, friendly tone, describing her running experiences. Her speech rate is moderate and well-articulated. (2) A digital 'ding' transition sound signals a shift in speaker. A male voice with a deeper, more resonant quality enters the conversation, maintaining a calm and professional demeanor. The background music continues consistently at a slightly lower volume to ensure vocal clarity. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition to event footage. Ambient sounds of distant laughter and collective chatter from a crowd are heard, overlaid with the ongoing BGM. The interviewer's voice remains dominant and energetically drives the narrative forward.
